architecture: 36 causal log-probability history + availability masks -> 4 centered residual logits;148 parameters; zero initialization
loss: Unweighted future CE +0.01 mean squared centered logit correction
normalization: 68 internal-fit training recordings only; never development or historical test
epoch_selection: 16 internal holdout recordings mean window NLL; keep zero-residual identity when no epoch improves
decision: Original Future0.5/K2; unchanged Current0.8/K2 Prompt; exact from/to one-to-one [b-1.5,b)
candidate_gate: Three-seed mean strict recall improves without increasing mean false/min; seed42 recall improves without increasing its false/min. Prompt traces must be identical. No automatic deployment.
validation: One fixed exploratory evaluation on eight development recordings; no parameter sweep; no historical test arrays
limitations: Frozen B0 previously fit some internal-holdout recordings; holdout is independent for residual fitting only, not the whole pipeline. B0 original normalization retained. New independent recordings still required.
